1235. Sparse Matrix Operations

Problem Statement:
You are required to implement a structure-based sparse matrix representation. A sparse matrix is one in which the majority of the elements are zero. Your task is to store only the non-zero elements using an array of structures and then perform basic matrix operations (addition and subtraction) on the sparse matrices.

Define a structure SparseMatrixElement that contains three fields: row, col, and value, representing the row index, column index, and the value of the non-zero element in the matrix, respectively.
Implement functions to:
1. Create a sparse matrix by reading user inputs and storing only non-zero elements.
2. Add two sparse matrices and return the result as a new sparse matrix.
3. Subtract one sparse matrix from another and return the result as a new sparse matrix.
